params.description: The ID of the deployment sending the app event.

items.docs: Send a journey app event, used for tracking customer activity on an application.

params.name: deploymentId
params.description: The ID of the deployment sending the ping.

params.name: customerCookieId
params.description: ID of the customer associated with the ping.

params.name: dl
params.description: Document Location: 1) Web Page URL if overridden or URL fragment identifier (window.location.hash). OR  2) Application screen name that the ping request was sent from in the app. e.g. 'home' or 'help. Pings without this parameter will not return actions.

params.name: dt
params.description: Document Title.  A human readable name for the page or screen

params.name: appNamespace
params.description: Namespace of the application (e.g. com.genesys.bancodinero). Used for domain filtering in application sessions

params.name: sessionId
params.description: UUID of the customer session. Use the same Session Id for all pings, AppEvents and ActionEvents in the session

params.name: sinceLastBeaconMilliseconds
params.description: How long (milliseconds) since the last app event or beacon was sent. The response may return a pollInternvalMilliseconds to reduce the frequency of pings.

items.docs: Send a ping.
